title: Visual Memory and Media Study
shortDescription: This study is a short task where you view photographs and answer memory questions. It takes about 15–20 minutes.
consentText: This research is for academic purposes and your responses will be handled anonymously. Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. If you agree, you may begin below.
baselinePhaseInstructions: The following images are similar to everyday, news, or documentary-style scenes. Browse each scene naturally. Swipe the screen or use the buttons to move between images. After the minimum viewing time (about 1 minute), the study will move on automatically.
conditionPhaseInstructions: This set is either the same static scenes as before (no edit) or AI-edited versions, depending on your assigned condition. You cannot return to the previous set. Use the Next/Previous buttons to browse all 12 items. After about 1 minute, the study will move on automatically.
memoryPhaseInstructions: The questions below refer to the original photographs you saw first. For each item, choose Agree / Disagree / Not sure, then rate how confident you are on a scale of 1–7.

conditionLabels.no_edit: No edit (same static image as original)
